thread.title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs

author: MacDailyNews
title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs
text:
Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs Friday, May 4, 2018 · 4:30 pm · 9 Comments In Nasdaq trading today, shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) rose $6.94, or 3.92%, to hit a new all-time closing high of $183.83. Apple’s previous all-time closing high was $181.72 set on March 12, 2018.
AAPL’s all-time intraday high stands at $184.25, also set today.
Apple’s 52-week low stands at $142.20.
Apple, the world’s most valuable company, currently has a market value of $932.755 billion.
